nodes.label: AgentService shared service
nodes.rationale: MCP layer is a thin adapter; REST calls the same functions (R-13) so both surfaces share one implementation.

nodes.label: /mcp MCP server (Streamable HTTP)
nodes.rationale: Stateless handler (new server instance per request); 2025 clients served via SDK compatibility path.

nodes.label: Origin header check (DNS-rebinding protection)
nodes.rationale: Foreign Origin -> 403; missing Origin allowed for server clients.

nodes.label: Agent access only to 'for agents' notebooks
nodes.rationale: Checked on every request so switching a notebook to private instantly revokes access (D-04).

nodes.label: Grant (static / oauth agent permission)
nodes.rationale: Revoking a grant immediately invalidates all its tokens.

nodes.label: Permissions read / read_write and scopes notes:read, notes:write
Token formats (dsa_, dso_at_, dso_rt_, dso_code_)
nodes.rationale: Only SHA-256 hashes stored; token only in Authorization Bearer header, never URL; refresh tokens rotate.

nodes.label: Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD)
nodes.rationale: HTTPS only, public addresses only, <=64 KiB, 5 s, 24h cache; CIMD clients are public only.

nodes.label: OAuth consent screen ('Quiet paper' server HTML page)
nodes.rationale: No JS/external resources, CSP frame-ancestors 'none', HMAC-signed form state 15 min; errors before redirect_uri check shown as page to prevent open redirect.

nodes.label: Agent error format (isError, {error:{code,message}})
nodes.rationale: Messages written for the model: what is wrong and what to do.

nodes.label: Agent Markdown dialect (block markers, tasks, callouts)
Handwriting in Markdown ![✍️ desc](handwriting:id) (D-11)
nodes.rationale: Russian description derived from stroke hint and underlying text expanded to whole words.

nodes.label: Handwriting group (strokes within 24 chars, handwritingId = earliest stroke)
edit_note atomic operations (insert, replace, delete, move, replace_text) (D-10)
nodes.rationale: Atomic: if any op fails nothing changes.

nodes.label: Handwriting preservation on agent edits
nodes.rationale: replace_text changes only the differing middle so Yjs items and stroke anchors survive; move copies block and rewrites anchors.

nodes.label: Agent edit as Yjs update via context.data.applyUpdate with agent origin
nodes.rationale: Server encrypts, assigns seq, stores in version history; rollback via version history.

nodes.label: Handwriting PNG render (@napi-rs/canvas, Inter/Newsreader)
nodes.rationale: Bundled fonts make the image identical on any machine; in-process cache of 200 images keyed by user/note/seq/group/scale.

nodes.label: AuditEntry agent call journal
nodes.rationale: Both successes and failures logged; journal write failure does not break operation.

nodes.label: In-process rate limits (120/min per grant, 30/min per IP on oauth) (D-25)
AgentsContext plugin-server interface
nodes.rationale: Optional grantId lets server run queries under RLS role limited to grant notebooks (D-30).

nodes.label: context.store (grants, OAuth clients, codes, tokens, audit)
Notebook/space names duplicated in notebook doc meta
nodes.rationale: Coordinator decision 2026-10-25: plugin uses AgentNotebook values if known, else notebook meta, else 'Untitled'.

PostgreSQL Row-Level Security for agent grants
